tools.name: cheapest_business_class_from
tools.description: Long-haul destinations from a departure city ranked by cheapest round-trip business class fare. Use for "where can I fly business class cheaply from X".

tools.name: cheapest_business_class_to
tools.description: Departure cities ranked by cheapest round-trip business class fare to a destination. Use for "cheapest place to fly business class to X from".

tools.name: business_class_deals
tools.description: Long-haul business class routes currently priced at least 20% below their own daily price history or distance-band median, ranked by biggest discount. Optional `from` filters to one departure city.

tools.name: first_class_fares
tools.description: First Class suites & flagship cabins (trip_class=2) round-trip fares on long-haul routes from Aviasales data, ranked cheapest first, with First Class booking links. Optional `from` filters to one departure city.

tools.name: check_business_or_first_price
tools.description: Business class & First class price check: evaluates whether a fare quoted elsewhere (in EUR, round trip per adult) is a steal, good, fair or overpriced vs our daily route history and distance benchmark, and returns a cheaper Aviasales booking link if we observed a lower price.

tools.name: compare_departure_hubs
tools.description: Business class & First class positioning comparison: checks nearby and same-country departure airports/cities to the same destination to find €500–€2,500+ savings (e.g. flying from Milan, Dublin, Warsaw or Madrid instead of London, Zurich or Frankfurt).
